business_summary.text: Gabriel India manufactures shock absorbers, struts and front forks for two-wheelers, passenger cars and commercial vehicles, and is expanding into sunroofs, fasteners, lubricants and solar dampers.

call_points.text: Aftermarket sales grew 8.3% YoY in FY26; 249 new SKUs were launched.
IGSSPL added a second sunroof line of 200,000 units in FY26, doubling capacity at the Chennai plant.
Solar damper orders were won from 3 customers; samples were submitted to export customers and feedback is awaited.

operating_notes.text: Demerged undertaking includes investments in Dana Anand India Private Limited, Henkel Anand India Private Limited, and Anand CY Myutec Automotive Private Limited.
Composite Scheme of Arrangement became operative, transferring Asia Investments' demerged automotive undertaking to Gabriel India.
FY26 standalone net working capital days fell to 28 from 29 in FY25.
Exports were 3% of standalone revenue in Q4FY26.
Aftermarket sales grew 8.3% YoY in FY26 with 249 new SKUs launched.

timeline.summary: Shareholders approved re-appointment of Mrs. Pallavi Joshi Bakhru (DIN: 01526618) as Independent Director for five years, effective May 26, 2026, with 91.88% voting in favor.
NCLT Mumbai sanctioned the Composite Scheme of Arrangement for demerger of Asia Investments' Automotive Undertaking into Gabriel India.
On May 22, 2026, Gabriel India announced the effective date of the Composite Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger undertaking.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,209.59 Cr (+12.7% YoY), net profit ₹66.5 Cr (+3.3% YoY).
Gabriel India's FY26 investor presentation reported consolidated revenue of ₹4,667 Cr (+14.9% YoY) and PAT of ₹252 Cr; with the Asia Investments demerger operative from May 22, 2026.

Anfilco Limited (on behalf of Anand Automobiles) disclosed receipt of 3,29,22,161 Gabriel India shares (18.58%) under the court-approved demerger scheme, taking promoter group holding from 55.02% to 63.55%.
On 19 October 2026, Gabriel India incorporated its joint venture Faurecia Anand Seating India Private Limited with a ₹20 Cr initial investment.
